purpose: Make ACK useful by requiring every worker/team loop to consume ACK packets, bounce unresolved cells back to the owning surface, meter owner harm/cog/time, and refuse false progression when RETURN/APPLY/REAP is missing.
why_this_exists: An ACK ledger by itself is comment stew. The SDK must provide the reusable primitive that other agents, Inbox, Studio, Switchboard, Benchmark, Ward, Bins and CLI can consume.

bounce_rules.missing_ack: bounce to owner/team ACK surface before selecting new work
bounce_rules.missing_attempt: do not claim execution; return WAIT_ATTEMPT with exact blocker
bounce_rules.missing_result: do not claim progress; return ATTEMPT_WITHOUT_RESULT
bounce_rules.missing_return: do not continue downstream; return RESULT_STRANDED
bounce_rules.missing_apply_return: do not mark parent current; return APPLY_RETURN_MISSING
bounce_rules.missing_readback: source commit/prose is insufficient; return READBACK_MISSING
bounce_rules.missing_reap: new surface stays STEW_RISK until 10:1 or denominator exhaustion is recorded

metered_billing_syncopation.unit: owner-cog/time/harm meter; no real billing side effect by default
metered_billing_syncopation.rule: Every bounce carries tic/cog/hope/trust/time=$ deltas where owner manually turned a machine-resolvable cog.
metered_billing_syncopation.fanout_rule: Only fan out after ACK packet is compiled and density-selected. Do not flood teams with uncompiled seams.
metered_billing_syncopation.game_loop: score PASS only when the ACK packet advances a real lifecycle cell or returns a typed WAIT with exact wake. Repeated prose ACK earns 0.

team_sync_contract.team_rule: Teams consume the same ACK packet; local OORs differ but shared goal and return target remain bound.
team_sync_contract.return_surface: root ACK ledger + consuming app projection

acceptance_gates.B01_ACK_PACKET_PRESENT: ACK packet exists and has required fields
acceptance_gates.B03_BOUNCE_ON_MISSING_RETURN: RESULT without RETURN creates bounce, not pass
acceptance_gates.B04_BOUNCE_ON_MISSING_APPLY: RETURN without APPLY_RETURN creates bounce, not parent-current
acceptance_gates.B05_METER_PRESENT: owner cog/time/harm fields present where owner correction caused action
acceptance_gates.B07_CONSUMERS_BOUND: required consumers are represented or typed WAIT
acceptance_gates.B09_REAP_ACCOUNTED: new surfaces have reap state or WAIT_REAP
acceptance_gates.B10_NO_PROSE_ONLY_ACK: chat/prose acknowledgment cannot satisfy SDK ACK primitive

next: Add a node-free SDK validator, then update xi-io.net blastwave chain and Studio active packet to mark SDK primitive bound instead of WAIT.
